channel.title: Black Panther Store - Astronomy Shirts
channel.description: Daily featured design for Astronomy Shirts

item.title: Deep Space - Pink T-Shirt
item.description: Our awesome galaxy with its stars, planets, interstellar gas, dust, dark matter and stellar remnants has always peak my interest since I was a small boy. During night times on our farm, I could look up into the sky for hours on end, enjoying our beautiful creation. Of course, the real beauty only comes to light once you look at our planet system via strong telescopes. Anyhow, I created this stunning and beautiful image with photoshop, with the help from online youtube video’s. Hope you enjoy it too.

item.title: Captain Scarlet & The Mysterons T-Shirt
item.description: Gerry Anderson's New Captain Scarlet, which debuted in February 2005, is a remake of the original and classic 1967 Supermarionation series, Captain Scarlet and the Mysterons, created by Gerry and Sylvia Anderson. It was a huge success and lead to films, DVD’s, toys, t-shirts and lots more. In the year 2068, peace on Earth is maintained by the Spectrum Organization, headquartered in the vast floating aircraft carrier Skybase, which hovers on the edge of Earth's atmosphere. Captain Scarlet is the main character and he has to battle the Alien nemeses from Mars, namely The Mysterons. I made this design to give credit to this brilliant CGI animation series, which is still one of my top three animations of all time.
